items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: He had his big band in there, with Rueben Reeves -- was a terrific trumpet player at that time.

ctx.x: Well, was Sammy Stewart the same type --

Yeah, he was the same -- see, those bands 15, 16, 17 men. And they just had a front man, he would be like the front man for them. Right, and so this is what happened. Then across the street at the Regal Theatre, they had Dave Peyton. He had his big band in there, with Rueben Reeves -- was a terrific trumpet player at that time.

And people used to lay for those shows and stage A when they would bring Louis Armstrong in there, man, this was really the thing, because you're going to hear Rueben Reeves and you'll hear Louis Armstrong.
